title: Fixed duplicate claim creation in batch processing
details: ClaimCenter batch claim import process no longer creates duplicate claims when source data contains repeated claim references. Fix ensures idempotency: re-running same batch produces single claim, not multiple. Applies to all batch import types (manual, scheduled, API-triggered).

title: Performance may vary in certain scenarios
details: Known issue identified in testing. Under specific conditions, performance may vary. Workaround: monitor system metrics. Updates coming in future release.

title: New webhook support for PolicyCenter and ClaimCenter events
details: IntegrationGateway now supports outbound webhooks for PolicyCenter and ClaimCenter lifecycle events: policy_created, policy_updated, claim_submitted, claim_approved, claim_closed. Webhooks can be configured per entity type with custom headers and retry logic. Enables real-time integrations with third-party systems (Salesforce, Slack, custom APIs).
